# Tickets

The tickets (`tickets/<DATE>_<SLUG>.md`, with their `.plan.md` and `.lock.md` siblings) live on the branch `agent-data`, never on a code branch. A `tickets` link at the repository root, if present, is a possibly stale copy: never write there.

Read and change them with the `tickets` command, always run by its full name: `npx @openagt/skill-tickets@0.1`. Every change it makes is one commit on the `agent-data` branch, pushed straight to the remote when the project shares its records. Never pass `--local` or `--force`: they are a person's.

Every command prints one JSON document; a refusal is `{"ok":false,"reason":…}` with why on stderr, exit 1; a wrong command line prints the usage on stderr, nothing on stdout, exit 2. Every `<file>` below is a ticket's filename (`2042-01-01_some-ticket.md`) or the `tickets/…` path a queue entry links to; `put` also takes the ticket's `.plan.md` and `meta.json`.

## Read

```
npx @openagt/skill-tickets@0.1 list                 every open ticket, as one JSON array; a row: file, title, summary, date,
                                                    planned, and when set priority, topics, issue, pr (set: the ticket is in
                                                    review), waiting (what it waits on), effort, uncertainty, outdated (the
                                                    plan says so), locked, lockedBy
npx @openagt/skill-tickets@0.1 show <file>          one ticket: its text, its plan, who holds it
npx @openagt/skill-tickets@0.1 meta                 when the tickets last caught up with the issue tracker:
                                                    {"lastImportedAt": <ISO 8601>}, or {} when no import was recorded
```

# The agent queue

The agent queue (`TODO_AGENTS.md`) lives on the branch `agent-data`, never on a code branch; your checkout does not contain it. It lists every task agents will work on next, in the order they will be taken.

Read and change it with the `queue` command, always run by its full name: `npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1`. Every change it makes is one commit on the `agent-data` branch, pushed straight to the remote when the project shares its records. The command's `--local` and `--full` flags are for the dashboard that shows the queue; never use them. A refusal exits 1 with a line on stderr; a wrong command line exits 2 with the usage.

## Read

```
npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1                        the open entries, in order of work, as one JSON array
```

## Change

```
npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1 add <text> [--priority N]
                                                    put an entry on the queue; --priority (0-10) places it at the end of
                                                    that section; without it, the entry goes at the end of the file
npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1 done <entry>           remove an entry: one quoted argument, exactly as `npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1`
                                                    printed it; done means deleted
```

## Format

```md
## Priority 10 (critical — act immediately)

...

## Priority 9

- [Succinct description](/link-for-more-details)
- Or self-contained TODO item with complete description of what should be done

...

## Priority 0 (only if capacity)

...
```

The queue lists *all* tasks AI will work on next, sorted by priority. Priority 10 is rarely used (e.g. critical production bugs) and is treated as the utmost priority. Within a priority, the first tasks have higher priority (they are the "next" tasks within that "priority queue"). A done entry is removed (`npx @openagt/skill-queue@0.1 done`).

# Karten-Bounds, Kategorienavigation und klickbare Marker im Astro-MapShell umsetzen

## TLDR

Die bestehende Astro-/MapLibre-Karte soll auf "'`/map/`, `/map/overview/` und Kategorie-Seiten die jeweils passenden Orte als klickbare Marker zeigen und deren Bounds in den tatsächlich freien Kartenbereich einpassen. Kategorienavigation, lokalisierte Place-Links und die bestehende persistente MapShell sollen sauber integriert werden.

## Warum es wichtig ist

Das Ticket beschreibt einen konkreten agentischen Umsetzungsplan für die Karten-, Kategorie- und Navigationsansichten. Es gibt bisher keine Overview-Marker oder implementierte Kategorie-Routen; die Karte soll in allen Ansichten zur jeweiligen sichtbaren Ortsmenge passen.

## Geprüfter Ausgangsstand

- Astro `main`: [`f575c36`](https://github.com/richard-unterberg/astro-maplibre/commit/f575c363fb886dee82335c89340f32e2057a6df5).
- Designreferenz Vike `master`: [`ff66451`](https://github.com/richard-unterberg/maplibre-vike/commit/ff664513546d67d15b14c8936ad706fecbfad049).

- `layouts/MapShell.astro` persistiert den Karten-DOM und aktualisiert auf `astro:page-load`; `map/placeFocus.ts` nutzt einen Standard-Pin und festen Offset.
- Overview- und Place-Seiten haben untenliegende Container; die Kategorie-Route ist angelegt, aber leer. Header hat Logo, Locale- und Theme-Switch.
